description: This Java source file defines the implementation of a generic message sender for the Hono framework, supporting AMQP messaging. It extends an abstract client class and implements a MessageSender interface, providing methods to create, send messages, handle connection states, and close the sender.

classes.name: GenericMessageSenderImpl
classes.description: A class providing a generic implementation of a message sender in the Hono framework using AMQP protocol, supporting message sending, flow control, and connection management.

methods.name: GenericMessageSenderImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sender with a HonoConnection and ProtonSender.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to asynchronously create a new GenericMessageSenderImpl for a given target address with a close hook handler.

methods.name: getCredit
methods.description: Returns the current available credit for sending messages.

methods.name: sendQueueDrainHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler to be invoked when the send queue is drained.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Method stub returning null, possibly placeholder for endpoint info.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the sender with a provided asynchronous handler.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks whether the sender connection is open.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message asynchronously if the sender is open and has credit, returning a Future with the delivery outcome.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the peer's outcome, handling accepted, released, or other remote states.
